steps.en: The list of excluded IDs is loaded
steps.why_en: If reading the opt-out list fails, the job continues as if nobody opted out
steps.why_id: Jika daftar opt-out gagal dibaca, job lanjut seolah tidak ada yang opt-out

steps.en: The offender's ID is checked against the list
Listed IDs get no electronic notice
steps.id: ID di daftar tidak dikirimi notifikasi elektronik

steps.en: Other IDs go on to be notified
The same check runs when a notice enters the notification stage
steps.id: Cek yang sama jalan saat notice masuk tahap notifikasi
